# Ezekiel 3 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 3:8 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Behold, I-have-made your-face strong against their-faces, and-your-forehead strong against their-foreheads. |
| LOGOS | Behold, I have made your face as hard as their faces, and your forehead as hard as their foreheads. |
| PNEUMA | So I'm making you just as tough as they are — your face as hard as their faces, your determination as fierce as their stubbornness. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 3:12 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-spirit lifted-me, and-I-heard behind-me [the]-sound-of a-great rushing: "Blessed [be the]-glory-of YHWH from-His-place!" |
| LOGOS | Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the sound of a great earthquake: "Blessed be the glory of the LORD from His place!" |
| PNEUMA | Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a tremendous rumbling sound — "Praise the glory of the LORD from His dwelling place!" |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 3:13 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-[the]-sound-of [the]-wings-of the-living-creatures touching each-one her-sister, and-[the]-sound-of the-wheels beside-them, and-[the]-sound-of a-great rushing. |
| LOGOS | It was the sound of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the sound of the wheels beside them, and the sound of a great earthquake. |
| PNEUMA | It was the sound of the living creatures' wings brushing against each other, and the rumbling of the wheels, and a great thunderous roar. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 3:18 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | In-My-saying to-the-wicked, 'Dying you-shall-die,' and-you-do-not-warn-him and-you-do-not-speak to-warn the-wicked from-his-way, the-wicked-one — he in-his-iniquity will-die, but-his-blood from-your-hand I-will-require. |
| LOGOS | If I say to the wicked, 'You shall surely die,' and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, in order to save his life, that wicked person shall die for his iniquity, but his blood I will require at your hand. |
| PNEUMA | If I warn the wicked that they will die, and you fail to pass on the warning — if you don't tell them to change their ways to save their lives — they will die in their sins, but I will hold you responsible for their deaths. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 3:20 (overlap: 3%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-in-the-turning-of [the]-righteous from-his-righteousness, and-he-does injustice, and-I-put a-stumbling-block before-him — he will-die; because you-did-not-warn-him, in-his-sin he-will-die, and-his-righteous-deeds which he-did will-not-be-remembered, but-his-blood from-your-hand I-will-require. |
| LOGOS | Again, if a righteous person turns from his righteousness and commits injustice, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he shall die. Because you have not warned him, he shall die for his sin, and his righteous deeds that he has done shall not be remembered, but his blood I will require at your hand. |
| PNEUMA | And if a righteous person turns away from doing right and starts doing evil, and I put an obstacle in their path, they will die. Because you didn't warn them, they will die in their sin. Their previous good deeds won't count for anything — and I will hold you responsible. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 3:3 (overlap: 5%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-He-said to-me, "Son-of man, your-belly you-shall-fill and-your-inward-parts you-shall-fill with-this scroll which I [am]-giving to-you." And-I-ate, and-it-was in-my-mouth like-honey for-sweetness. |
| LOGOS | And He said to me, "Son of man, feed your belly with this scroll that I give you and fill your stomach with it." Then I ate it, and it was in my mouth as sweet as honey. |
| PNEUMA | "Eat it all," He told me. "Fill your stomach with it." So I ate it, and it tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
